text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: ...The hell did you say? Say that again!

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ha, I'll say it as many times as it
takes! 
You don't have that fire in you like you 
used to—

text_block_list.name: Sharp-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Entering such a well-mannered school has 
really softened you up, hasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
—Hey.
Can we make this training routine... 
a bit tougher?

text_block_list.text:

day told me, 'You've really mellowed out.'

text_block_list.text:

trend. The change was even starting to 
show on the outside.

soft... I mean, are you serious? Dammit.

all the way! Drop the soft attitude. Got 
it?
